notes.title: Preliminary Crew System is out in the Pre-Alpha Branch
notes.content:
We've been working hard on creating a dynamic crew system in a large scale game with a full function and customizable ship. It was not an easy task, but we have the first taste of it in this pre-alpha branch update. Here's a quick summary of what's new in this update:

[list]
[*] Created Video Options Menu system
[*] In-game options menu system overhaul (still a work in progress)
[*] Created Crew Management System and variables
[*] Added Crew Stats system
[*] Added Game time system and dynamic time variables
[*] Added time-scaling system for future bullet-time gameplay
[*] Add turbo-lift system for Ship cores
[*] Added Lobbies for ship cores for crew standby
[*] Added Crew Hiring system
[*] Added 5 Available Crews for hire
[*] Added save system for crews and stats
[*] Created Dialogue system for Sandbox Mode
[*] Added an Engine Room to ship cores
[*] Added transparency view for ship inspection in the build mode
[*] 
[/list]

Not only that you can build and fly your capital ship, you now can hire crews!
We would love to get some early feedback for our crew system. It's still early, but as always, the hard part is behind the scene making sure the system works well with save/load and that every function works with one another. Needless to say, there will be bugs, and there will be glitches, but the goal is to see if you all think this concept of having crews do stuff around your ship is something fun or not?

Looking forward to hearing your thoughts!

notes.title: Sandbox Mode Now Supports VR (as of 1.08)
notes.content:
Why add VR? Well, Why not? Don't worry, this won't take us away from the main road map. It was not a lot for us to add this feature. However, this game is not a VR game, so our VR feature is only there to let players admire the ship they build in an immersive way.

Update notes:
- added Steam VR support
- added the VR Station furniture
- added VR drone that lets player take a virtual tour of the ship when using the VR Station
- added VR player controller and collision physics (not perfect, you might fall out the ship and have to restart the game)
- added teleportation mechanics in VR
- added a RoboCorp Droid on to the RoboBed furniture
- added ragdoll physics to RoboCorp Droid on the RoboBed furniture when entered VR mode

To take the VR tour of your ship:
1) go to the hanger and install the VR Station furniture into a ship module
2) attach the ship module with the VR Station to your capital ship
3) walk up to the ship and enter VR mode
4) put on your VR headset
5) Controls: movement - Left controller thumbstick, turn - Right controller thumbstick, teleportation - Right controller thumbstick Click
6) to exit VR, go back to the VR station and physically push the "Exit VR" button in VR then take off your VR headset to resume the game

Please note that the framerate might drop a few (not too noticeable) after you exit VR and have the VR headset plugged in. To increase framerate back to normal, simply unplug the VR headset and select "quit SteamVR" when prompted. This framerate glitch will be fixed in a later update.

Don't forget to join our Discord Channel! we get lots of great ideas from you guys there.
https://discord.gg/fn6JQnb

notes.title: 2nd Sandbox Mode Pre-Alpha update is out
notes.content:
Not bad for a week worth of work! at this rate, we'll have a full functioning Sandbox in no time!
Thank you all who participate in our Pre-Alpha and being a part of our Discord channel! You guys really make our community come alive! I will do my best to make this game, a space game you've always wanted to play :)

** Things to note **
- As of this update, you still cannot fly the capital ship, we still need to work on the navigation system, A.I., and many other mechanics before we lift the curfew on the big boat
- Please take it easy on the walls and colliders during EVA flight, otherwise, you might get sucked out into space without an EVA suit!!! We are still working hard to continue to make the character system a good one. What we are trying to accomplish has not been done much before, so we kind of have to write our own book as we go sorta speak.
- Buy/Sell is coming in the next update, so as of now you still cannot sell-off or modify your modules.
- Mining is pointless at the moment since you still cannot sell what you've gathered, and there are no processing facilities. That is also coming in the next update.

notes.title: Sandbox Pre-Alpha is out tomorrow!
notes.content:
This is a soft launch of the Sandbox early pre-alpha for some early feedback.
We are looking to test out the following game features:
1) Ship construction:
- Ship modules buying interface user experience
- Module customizing user experience
- Ship assembly interface user experience
2) free-roaming Space gameplay
- EVA flight and maneuvering system
- Basic Manual Mining with the plasma rifle
3) Ship controls
- Basic non-combat ship controls
- Getting in and out of the spacecraft
4) Environment
- The atmosphere of the game
- Transitioning between space and inside of a pressurized facility with artificial gravity
- Traveling time
Please note that you cannot fly the capital ship in this build, nor can you sell or save the ship at the moment. There might also be major glitches we haven't come across. 

Please feel free to skip this build and wait for the next one that is scheduled to be released by the end of January for more features.  

We hope you enjoy!
